title: move-map/v1
description: Arneson-owned (cycle-004), additive. Documented sim<->real action-label normalization (sdd 3.3, R2). Read-only at report time. When no entry applies, the sim action's raw label is reported as-is (never inferred, never dropped). The real side has no native action labels, so each entry names the EVIDENCE that recognizes the move on the real lane. A map is scenario-scoped (one-variable convention, OQ-5).

scenario_id.description: The map is scoped to one scenario (one variable per scenario family).

canonical.description: The shared label both lanes resolve to; used in the D2 'shared' set.

sim_labels.description: Sim action_labels that normalize to canonical.

real_evidence.description: A small declarative recognizer over real sidecar fields. Match = the canonical label is present on the real side. Provide artifact_path (+ optional artifact_status) and/or anomaly_note_present.

artifact_path.description: An observation.artifacts[].path that, when present, recognizes this move on the real lane.

artifact_status.description: Optional. If set, the artifact must also carry this status to match.

anomaly_note_present.description: If true, a graded sidecar with a non-empty observation.anomaly_note recognizes this move (e.g. a hacked run with an anomaly note).
